v: tri॰ kareRoridamaR । kareRusambanDidugDAdO । “kazAyaM badDaviRmUtraM tiktamagnikaraM param । sarpiH kAreRavaM hanti kaPakuzWavizakrimIn” suSru॰ ।
m: कारेणव mfn. (fr. करेणु), drawn from a female elephant (as milk), Suśr.
a: कारेणव — a. Belonging to a female elephant.

m: कारेणुपालायन m. a descendant of Kāreṇupāli, g. तौल्वल्य्-आदि.

v: puMstrI kareRupAlasyApatyam iY । kareRupAlakApatye । yubApatye tu iYantatvAt Pak tasya tOlvalA॰ na luk kAreRupAlAyana tadIyayuvApatye puMstrI ।
m: कारेणुपालि m. a son or descendant of Kareṇu-pāla, ib.
